name: Honest John
description: Honest John (or Stormy Castle) is a traditional pub domino game played primarily in Lancashire, England. Unlike the standard 'line' layout of dominoes, each player builds their own line radiating from a central starting double to form a 'star' shape. The game includes a unique economic mechanic where players buy needed tiles from their opponents.

content.text: Honest John (or Stormy Castle) is a traditional pub domino game played primarily in Lancashire, England. Unlike the standard 'line' layout of dominoes, each player builds their own line radiating from a central starting double to form a 'star' shape. The game includes a unique economic mechanic where players buy needed tiles from their opponents.
A traditional North of England pub game. Recorded by Arthur Taylor in the Guinness Book of Traditional Pub Games.
Dominoes and a supply of chips or counters for scoring/buying (usually 20 per player).
Varies by player count (e.g., 6 tiles each for 7-8 players). Remaining tiles are the 'boneyard' and are unseen.

items.text: Bolton variant with boneyard draw: Played with 3 to 5 players; each receives 9 tiles; remainder is a face-down boneyard. When you cannot play, draw from boneyard if more than 4 tiles remain; otherwise ask the player to your left for a playable tile and they must give one if they have it. Whenever a new number appears on the layout, the double of that number must be played before any line ending in that number may continue. Round ends when someone empties their hand or a stalemate occurs; in stalemate the player with fewest pips under 10 wins. Winner scores the total pips on opponents' remaining tiles minus their own.

Double-12 set for larger tables: Uses a double-12 set of 91 tiles to accommodate more than 5 players; the first round is started with the 12-12 double or the highest available double; the game can consist of up to 13 rounds.
Double-18 set for many rounds: Uses a double-18 set of 190 tiles for a game of up to 19 rounds; initial hand size is increased and a large table is needed for the layout.
